D1_what_each_arm_licenses.Q3: Whether the systemic/routine classification separates realised risk on one real network in one quarter. NOT that assigning different instruments to those classes helps anyone.
D1_what_each_arm_licenses.Q4: An execution kernel discriminating correctness where a text evaluator does not, on 20 implementations across 4 tasks. NOT that execution kernels solve evaluation generally, and NOT anything about prose.
D1_what_each_arm_licenses.Q5: Whether process telemetry beats static structure at separating archived from live repositories CONTEMPORANEOUSLY. NOT that tau_v is an early warning -- Q5_E records why that stays untestable here.

D2_the_two_confounds_removed_before_the_.note: A first draft of the Q4 artifacts had Spearman(word count, correct) = +0.3547 and Spearman(self-certifying, correct) = -0.7917. Both were leaks I authored: a length detector would have beaten chance and a 'distrust self-praise' heuristic would have nearly solved the task. The ARTIFACTS were rewritten, never a threshold, and the residuals are +0.0177 and 0.0000.

D3_the_edge_cases_were_locked_to_stop_me.note: The runner is written after the lock and I already knew every declared bug, so a post-hoc test bank could have been tuned to catch exactly those. The edge-case inputs are fixed in the specification; the runner may only add random property tests.

D4_corrections_to_the_proposal_this_spec.correction_1_the_ceiling_explanation_is_: The proposal states that Rule 110 defeated tau_v because a static oracle reached AUC ~0.99, leaving no headroom. Spec 0cd701a4 measured static prediction on the IRREDUCIBLE arm at 0.4940 -- chance. There was maximum headroom and monitoring gained +0.0051 anyway. The ~1.0 figures belong to the REDUCIBLE rules (1 and 5), which P5 never scored. 'No headroom' therefore cannot be why monitoring failed, and the GitHub head-to-head is a genuinely open question rather than a formality.
D4_corrections_to_the_proposal_this_spec.correction_2_the_tau_v_figures: The proposal cites 19.8 vs 50.6 days at p ~ 1e-31. Those are MEANS from the smaller four-cohort study, not this cohort. On the committed 992-repo file, restricted to non-imputed tau_v, the MEDIANS are 20.53 (alive) against 32.37 (archived) and the MEANS are 44.11 against 47.00 -- nearly identical, because the mean is dominated by a long tail. This spec uses the committed file and reports what it holds.
D4_corrections_to_the_proposal_this_spec.correction_3_Q3_cannot_be_licensed_by_a_: The proposal licenses Q3 on 10,000-event runs from three-proposals/. That engine is OUR OWN SIMULATOR. A policy winning inside a model we wrote is not evidence about the world, and this programme has refused that pattern fourteen times. Q3 is therefore re-scoped to the part that IS falsifiable on real data: whether the node classification the fixed-endpoint policy depends on actually separates realised outcomes.
